A '''cantina''' was located in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. Several members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]] went to the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] when they needed some rest and relaxation.
